name: Fujifilm Velvia 50
notes: First reversal (slide) stock: type positive_slide so the engine's is-negative flag is false - densities DECREASE with exposure (H&D control points are monotone decreasing), no orange mask, direct-positive print path. H&D approx from memory of Fujifilm Velvia 50 (RVP50) datasheet characteristic curves: D-max ~3.6, D-min ~0.18-0.20, steep straight-line (reversal gamma magnitude ~1.7-1.8), hard highlight shoulder and crushed shadows - the classic ~5-stop slide envelope. Mid-gray density ~1.05 is a reasoned anchor consistent with published curves. Grain: RMS Granularity 9 is from the Fujifilm Velvia 50 datasheet; pitch/shadow_bias engine-derived (fine tight grain). ESTIMATED: spectral crosstalk (narrow, pure layer separations feeding Velvia's saturation), inter-image/DIR matrix (E-6 inter-image effects expressed through the DIR stage - reasoned engine parameter, strong to push Velvia's vivid separation), halation (slides show little). scan_matrix carries diagonal gain ~2x: the engine's direct-positive path lands unscanned mid-gray near display 0.20, and real slide scanners expose the transparency up to mid-gray - this matrix is that scanner calibration (engine anchor verified in tests), with slight channel skew for Velvia's magenta-leaning vividness. print_paper block unused on the positive path, kept for schema uniformity. No local Velvia scans. Memory approximation. Grain keys flattened for the engine. 2026-07-11
